title: Figma: the collaborative interface design tool.
metaDescription: A better way to design. Design, prototype, and gather feedback all in one place with Figma.
h2: Collaborate with everyone, at every phase
bodyText: Figma: the collaborative interface design tool.This app works best with JavaScript enabled.FeaturesEnterprisePricingCustomersBlogSign InSign UpSign upA better way to design.Design, prototype, and collaborate all in the browser—with Figma.Try Figma for freeEmpowering innovative brandsAfter that first experience of sending a Figma link out and seeing others immediately jump in, there is no going back.Bryan Haggerty, Sr. Design Manager at TwitterCollaborate with everyone, at every phaseEach contributor owns their part of the creative process and stays in sync along the way—across any platform. Your designersCollaborate in context and in real time. Never worry about your files being out of date or overwriting each other’s work.Your stakeholdersSimply send a link to collect feedback, get change requests, and allow stakeholders to make copy updates in your designs.Your developersEngineers always have access to the current source-of-truth and can inspect elements, export assets, and copy code.Try Figma for freeIncrease efficiency with added flexibilityExplore a few of our favorite features, reimagined to improve your workflow.Team LibrariesShare components and styles in Figma—no need for shared drives or additional tools. You and your team control how and when changes are rolled out with simple publishing workflows.Learn moreComponentsBuild faster and more consistently with reusable and scalable elements across your files. Access layers in each instance so you can intuitively edit and override text and images inline.Learn moreStylesSynchronize colors, text, grids and effects across all your projects. Maintain fewer text styles and align your designs across different devices with Figma’s unique grid styles.Learn morePrototypingQuickly build flows by connecting screens and adding in elements like interactions, transitions, overlays, and more. Instead of syncing to other tools simply share a URL to receive feedback.Learn moreSecurely connect teams, fonts, and libraries across your entire company.Learn more about Figma OrganizationBuild design systems that scaleManage and easily share a consistent visual language with styles, components, and team libraries.Learn how Square scales their design systemsWatch nowStart building your design system in FigmaLearn howLearn from your peers with our State of Design Systems reportRead moreIt isn’t just that it replaces Sketch.
